skill.summary: Generates multiple bold, high-contrast YouTube thumbnail concepts with engaging expressions and text overlays for video content.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Generate YouTube Thumbnail Concepts skill.
- Creates multiple thumbnail concepts featuring bold text overlays, engaging expressions, and high-contrast designs.
- Designed for video creators, solopreneurs, and indie hackers to enhance YouTube content.
- Supports workflow from ideation to asset generation and refinement.
- Integrates `image_generation` and `chat` APIs for comprehensive thumbnail concept creation.
